prompt:
Make a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, The Runaway Misprint Foundry. The original inputs are style references for rounded footless whole dark charcoal-plum organic splat bodies, tiny ink hands, thick filled modeled eyelids, cream white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Exactly six independent complete upright figures in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 real transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. Keep each silhouette, drops and all held props within its own cell, generous clear alpha gutters and margins. No stage, floor, shadows, scenery, border, branding or labels. Large sparse hand-shaped marks, gentle smooth satin clay, broad fabric folds, clear glass and clean finished plastic. Avoid dense grit and stipple. Tiny costume accents, dominant ink body and distinct readable expressions. Teeth behind lips. Do not inherit reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Palette: Ink-stained warm linen, terracotta and muted brass. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read typesetter. tall tapered blob, raised brow and determined tight mouth. Key cue: one square wooden type block with a clearly backward raised capital R.
2. Male-read proofreader. low wide splat, narrowed sideways eyes and drooping lip. Key cue: one giant curved burgundy comma with a small wooden grip.
3. Male-read escaped typo. small broad asymmetrical blob at full sheet scale, raised startled eyes and a crooked smile. Key cue: small folded cream proof sheet with one simple smudged letter, used as a little shield while face remains visible.
4. Female-read press operator. upright curl, eyes aimed at roller and focused frown. Key cue: small hand brayer with a smooth dark roller and brass handle.
5. Male-read bookbinder. round heavy pear, gentle patient smile with head tilted. Key cue: palm-sized half-bound book and one thick thread loop.
6. Male-read margin inspector. squarish low blob with one suspicious raised eyelid, pursed mouth. Key cue: short wooden square ruler and one large blank cream page with a plain red border line.
Six distinct standalone cutouts and strongly differentiated body shapes.
